title: Daya Bay Reactor Neutrino Experiment
excerpt: 22°35′43″N 114°32′35″E; Operating Period: 2011–2020; eight antineutrino detectors, clustered in three locations within 1.9 km of six nuclear reactors, each containing 20 tons of liquid scintillator; researchers from China, Chile, the United States, Taiwan, Russia, and the Czech Republic; 40+ institutional collaborators.
